FFIRONSWORN.Label: Ironsworn / Starforged
FFIRONSWORN.CoreTooOld: FastFighting Ironsworn needs a newer FastFighting Core. Update FastFighting.
FFIRONSWORN.NeedsCore: FastFighting Ironsworn needs the FastFighting module. Enable it in Manage Modules.

rulesPreference.Name: Rules preference
rulesPreference.Hint: With more than one ruleset on, Ironsworn, Starforged and Sundered Isles have moves of the same name that play differently (Strike, Clash, Endure Harm, Enter the Fray). Follow character sheets: every character makes the moves of the sheet it's on now (an Ironsworn sheet's, a Starforged sheet's), even where that sheet shows other rulesets' moves too. Prefer a ruleset: where it has a move of the same name (and the world has it on), every character makes that ruleset's version. Moves called differently (End the Fight, Take Decisive Action) always stay the character's own.

deadlyWeapons.Name: Characters fight with deadly weapons
deadlyWeapons.Hint: Ironsworn: a deadly weapon (a sword, an axe, a spear, a bow) inflicts 2 harm, an unarmed attack or a simple weapon 1. On, characters strike for 2 harm (3 on a strong Strike); off, 1. Only Ironsworn's Strike and Clash inflict harm this way; Starforged's mark progress.

loreBoost.Name: Lore-Collector advantage
loreBoost.Hint: How much likelier a Lore-Collector's next attack or Compel (persuading, threatening, deceiving) is to succeed after it Secures an Advantage to size a foe up (on a hit; never without it). 1.25× is a nudge, 3× a sure thing more often than not. Default 2.35×: what it takes for that one roll to make up for the move it cost, with +3 wits hitting 77% of the time and a miss paying the price. Ironsworn's dice cap a roll near 95%, so a Strike gets all it can by about 1.5×; the rest helps Compel a hardier foe.

Burn.Strong: burns momentum ({n}): {label} is a strong hit
Burn.Weak: burns momentum ({n}): {label} is a weak hit

Endure.MortalDies: the harm is mortal (d100 {d100}); {face}: miss. Dies
Endure.MortalBack: the harm is mortal (d100 {d100}); {face}: cast back into the world, out of the fight
Endure.MortalBound: the harm is mortal (d100 {d100}); {face}: lives, bound to a deathbound quest, out of the fight
Endure.Dying: dying (d100 {d100}): needs healing within an hour or two

Stress.Desolate: overwhelmed (d100 {d100}); {face}: miss. Gives up the fight

Conflict.Title: Conflict
Conflict.Hint: How this encounter is tracked, as Ironsworn and Starforged play it: success is progress on a track; things going wrong cost health, spirit or supply.
Conflict.TrackHint: One track for the encounter (Starforged's objective, kept on one character), or each foe's own track (Ironsworn's).
Conflict.EncounterHint: Every hit (and every success in words) marks progress on one track, at the rank below. Take Decisive Action wins the objective; a miss loses it.
Conflict.FoesHint: Harm marks progress on each foe's own track, at its own rank. End the Fight takes that foe out of it.
Conflict.RankHint: How hard the objective is: how much each mark fills, and how many successes it takes to talk a foe round.
Conflict.HolderHint: The character whose sheet keeps the encounter's track (the others can follow it by hand).

Out.Deathbound: Survives Face Death, bound to a deathbound quest; out cold
Out.Dying: Dying: needs healing within an hour or two, or Face Death
